restrictedAnsatzCertificate.interpretation: The a=0 resultant root is extraneous; the remaining polynomial in a^2 has positive coefficients. Both real solutions make the nominal simple quartic have repeated roots, yielding partition(2,2,2,2,2,2). This excludes only this shared-D2 ansatz, not the full requested partition.

outcome.conclusion: No pattern-preserving third-order AC witness was established. The smallest selected-row residuals occur near additional root collisions; higher-precision diagnostics did not converge to a separated high-accuracy state. The selected row remains2–3.
outcome.limitations: This finite search and the restricted-ansatz exclusion are not global nonexistence proofs. Provisional double-precision candidates are not catalogue lower-bound improvements.
